# An interpreter of the StrongARM's instruction set (ARMCPU.h): ARMv4, ARM
# state, over a memory the caller supplies.  No Newton dependencies.
add_library(armcpu STATIC
    ARMCPU.cpp
    FPA.cpp
)
target_include_directories(armcpu PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# The adapter that runs packages' native functions on it
# (PackageNativeCPU.h): the fallback of frames/PackageNatives.h, the ROM's
# public jump table (PublicJumpTable.cpp, generated by
# tools/newton-rom/analysis/gluetable.py) answered on the host.
add_library(armcpu_frames STATIC
    PackageNativeCPU.cpp
    PublicJumpTable.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(armcpu_frames PUBLIC newton_config armcpu frames hal_host_card)
target_include_directories(armcpu_frames PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# Packages' protocol parts on the interpreter (ARMProtocols.h): the loader
# the package manager falls back on, the host class infos and proxies'
# plumbing, mirrors of host objects, and the protocol and name server glue.
add_library(armcpu_protocols STATIC
    ARMProtocols.cpp
    ARMKernelGlue.cpp
    ARMLists.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(armcpu_protocols PUBLIC newton_config armcpu_frames package_manager utility os600_user os600_kernel)
target_include_directories(armcpu_protocols PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# A package's card handler part on the interpreter (ARMCardHandler.h): the
# TCardHandler proxy and the card side's objects as the ARM code sees them.
add_library(armcpu_pcmcia STATIC
    ARMCardHandler.cpp
    ARMPSSManager.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(armcpu_pcmcia PUBLIC newton_config armcpu_protocols pcmcia hal_host_card flash)

add_subdirectory(tests)
